correctness.rationale: For every 0–1 mask S⊆F5², cyclotomic irreducibility equates nonzero Fourier zeros with five equal affine fibre populations, so convolution rank is 25 minus four times the count of balanced pencils, except empty/full cases. Projective sharp 3-transitivity makes N_t(w) pencil-independent. N1, N2, N4, N5 are proved by row choices, labelled bipartite 2-factors and Boolean two-line support rigidity. The only nontrivial finite coefficients N3(5)=15 and N3(10)=130 are computed by complete explicit enumeration over 3,125/100,000 row combinations, with source in line_incidence_checker.py. Binomial inversion gives all rank-by-weight counts and complement symmetry covers remaining weights. Independent full_direct_check.c exhausts all 33,554,432 masks and agrees exactly; every asserted count is an integer. No approximation or nonterminating computation supports the result.

value.rationale: The complete rank distribution answers a natural exact support-to-recovery question for binary convolution filters on the smallest odd-prime affine plane with a nontrivial three-direction deficiency stratum. It distinguishes seven ranks with exact population counts among 33,554,432 masks and resolves the rarity of each singularity level by exact support weight. The key intersection count N3(10)=130 and its integration with 2-factor and Fourier rigidity methods give a reusable finite-geometry enumeration framework. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary unmotivated numerical slice, and makes no unsupported downstream theorem claim.
